source: Samsung Refrigerator Bottom Mount Freezer Service Manual (RF195AC/RF197AC/RF215AC/RF217AC/RF18HFENB/RF20HFENB), Technical Service Guide 2009
content: The compressor does not start right after it stopped. The compressor does not work unless 5 minutes pass after it turned off upon satisfying the temperature; the compressor also does not work during defrosting. Check again after 5 minutes. If the compressor still does not run, it is not a normal delay.

metadata.symptom: The compressor does not start right after it stopped.
metadata.possible_cause: The compressor does not work unless 5 minutes pass after it turned off upon satisfying the temperature; the compressor also does not work during defrosting.
metadata.solution: Check again after 5 minutes. If the compressor still does not run, it is not a normal delay.

source: Samsung Refrigerator Bottom Mount Freezer Service Manual (RF195AC/RF197AC/RF215AC/RF217AC/RF18HFENB/RF20HFENB), Technical Service Guide 2009
content: The fans do not start immediately after the door is opened and closed, or after power is restored. Designed delays: at a high ambient temperature, after the door is opened and closed once, the fan operates after a 1 minute delay; after power is turned off and on, the unit starts with a 5 minute delay to prevent compressor overload; after a momentary power failure with the freezer temperature sensed at 41 F, the fans operate after 5 minutes; at a low ambient temperature (about 59 F / below 15 C) the compressor fan may not operate. Do not treat this as an error. Recheck after 5 minutes (the time may be longer depending on the temperature).

source: Samsung Refrigerator Bottom Mount Freezer Service Manual (RF195AC/RF197AC/RF215AC/RF217AC/RF18HFENB/RF20HFENB), Technical Service Guide 2009
content: The door alarm (ding-dong) sounds continuously. The alarm sounds after 2 minutes from the first door opening and repeats at 1 minute intervals. It also sounds when the door is not pressed completely closed, because the controller senses the door as open. The inner lamp turns off 10 minutes after the door-open state is sensed. 1. Check that the door is closed completely. 2. Remove anything interfering with the door, such as the door gasket or food.

metadata.possible_cause: The alarm sounds after 2 minutes from the first door opening and repeats at 1 minute intervals. It also sounds when the door is not pressed completely closed, because the controller senses the door as open. The inner lamp turns off 10 minutes after the door-open state is sensed.
metadata.solution:
1. Check that the door is closed completely.
2. Remove anything interfering with the door, such as the door gasket or food.

source: Samsung Refrigerator Bottom Mount Freezer Service Manual (RF195AC/RF197AC/RF215AC/RF217AC/RF18HFENB/RF20HFENB), Technical Service Guide 2009
content: A beep-beep alarm sounds continuously and the front display is off. The manual operation / manual defrost test mode is active. In manual operation the alarm beeps continuously (0.25 seconds ON / 0.75 seconds OFF) until the manual operation is completed. Cancel the manual operation / defrost function by turning the main power OFF and ON (pages 30-31).

source: Samsung Refrigerator Bottom Mount Freezer Service Manual (RF195AC/RF197AC/RF215AC/RF217AC/RF18HFENB/RF20HFENB), Technical Service Guide 2009
content: The refrigerator has no power (display off, not running). The power plug is not connected or is loose. 1. Connect the plug again. 2. Check that the plug is not loose.

metadata.symptom: The refrigerator has no power (display off, not running).
metadata.possible_cause: The power plug is not connected or is loose.
metadata.solution:
1. Connect the plug again.
2. Check that the plug is not loose.
metadata.safety_warning: Do not use a cord that shows cracks or abrasion damage along its length or at either end (page 17).

source: Samsung Refrigerator Bottom Mount Freezer Service Manual (RF195AC/RF197AC/RF215AC/RF217AC/RF18HFENB/RF20HFENB), Technical Service Guide 2009
content: The display, fans and lights work normally but the compressor does not run and the refrigerator does not cool. Exhibition / display mode is on. In this mode all functions such as the display and fan motor operate normally but the compressor does not operate and defrost is not operated. The mode stays on after power OFF and ON. Press the Power Freeze key and the Freezer key together (the mode is started by pressing them for 5 seconds with a ding-dong buzzer); pressing them repeatedly cancels exhibition / display mode. The mode also cancels automatically when the fresh food and freezer sensors read higher than 149 F (65 C).

metadata.solution: Press the Power Freeze key and the Freezer key together (the mode is started by pressing them for 5 seconds with a ding-dong buzzer); pressing them repeatedly cancels exhibition / display mode. source: Samsung Refrigerator Bottom Mount Freezer Service Manual (RF195AC/RF197AC/RF215AC/RF217AC/RF18HFENB/RF20HFENB), Technical Service Guide 2009
content: The temperature display LEDs blink at 0.5 second intervals when the refrigerator is first turned on. The self-diagnostic function detected a bad temperature sensor. There is no beep sound. The display does not operate normally and temperature is controlled by the emergency operation. The error cancels automatically when all troubled sensors are corrected, or when the Power Freeze key and Power Cool key are pressed together for 8 seconds (returns to normal display mode). Refer to the self-diagnostic check list (pages 33-34).
